name: pdf-master
description: PDF Master — Full-featured PDF management application

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.js';const dst='public/pdf.worker.min.js';if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,dst);console.log('PDF.js worker copied to public/');}else{console.warn('pdfjs-dist not found, run npm install pdfjs-dist');}"
